title: Width cutoff reciprocal bound
statement: Let $s$ be a natural number and let $\varepsilon>0$. Define the width cutoff $W$ to be the least natural number greater than or equal to $\log_2(s/\varepsilon)$. Then $s\,2^{-W}\le\varepsilon$.
